reliability_tasks.task_name: Partition Exam Submission DB & Implement Async Queueing
reliability_tasks.description: Eliminate database lock contention on submission ledger during exam turn-in spikes. Introduce Kafka/BullMQ async ingestion buffer.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Implement Resilient Client-Side Answer Auto-Cache & Offline Sync
reliability_tasks.description: Store answers in IndexedDB locally so students never lose progress if network drops during exam submission.

reliability_tasks.task_name: S3 Multipart Upload Circuit Breaker & Direct S3 Presigned URLs
reliability_tasks.description: Bypass API backend servers for heavy PDF/exam scan uploads. Upload directly to object storage via presigned URLs.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Scale Redis Session Cluster & Optimize SSO Token Caching
reliability_tasks.description: Increase Redis read-replicas to prevent 09:00 AM synchronized exam login bottleneck and session dropouts.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Graceful Fallback Auth Token Grace Period on WiFi Reconnect
reliability_tasks.description: Permit a 60-second grace window during active exams when student laptop switches access points or cellular hotspot.

reliability_tasks.task_name: WAF Rule Tuning for STEM LaTeX / Math Syntax in Requests
reliability_tasks.description: Prevent Cloudflare/Edge WAF false positives from blocking math equations containing SQL-like or script characters.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Tune Edge Gateway Keep-Alive & HTTP/2 Ingress Connection Pool
reliability_tasks.description: Increase backend proxy keep-alive sockets to eliminate TCP handshake resets during synchronized 5,000-student exam starts.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Multi-CDN Failover Routing for Course Syllabus & Formula Sheets
reliability_tasks.description: Ensure static exam formula PDFs and reference documents remain reachable even if primary CDN edge degrades.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Optimize HLS Video Segment Caching on Edge Edge-Locations
reliability_tasks.description: Warm CDN cache for high-demand exam prep lectures 24 hours before major midterms.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Automate Canary Deployments with Automated Error-Budget Rollbacks
reliability_tasks.description: Automatically rollback any deployment if 5-minute error budget burn rate exceeds 10x.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Database Deadlock Monitoring & Connection Pool Throttling
reliability_tasks.description: Add pgBouncer connection pooling and proactive lock query termination for slow analytics queries during exam hours.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Fix Transcoding Queue Lag for Video Replays
reliability_tasks.description: Offload non-critical lecture transcoding to off-peak worker spot instances.
Fix character encoding parser in video player for foreign language course subtitles.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Upgrade Course Content Search Engine Node Cluster
reliability_tasks.description: Add read replicas to search cluster to absorb pre-exam revision search spikes.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Implement Adaptive Rate-Limiting by Student Role & Active Exam Status
reliability_tasks.description: Guarantee zero rate-limiting for active exam test-takers while strictly throttling bot scrapers and crawling.

reliability_tasks.task_name: Setup Dedicated Exam Emergency Hotline Telemetry Ingestion
reliability_tasks.description: Ingest proctoring support desk phone tickets directly into real-time Prometheus alert pipeline.
